prompt: Which of these is an exact anagram of the word STRESSED, using every letter exactly once?
explanation: STRESSED uses the letters S three times, E twice, and T, R and D once each. DESSERTS uses exactly the same letters: D once, E twice, S three times, R once and T once. DESSERT is one S short.
